title: Clarify mail notification requirements
commit_message:
Clarify mail notification requirements 
Document support for /usr/bin/mail or /usr/sbin/sendmail and update the diagnostic wording. LP: #2169494
diff:
diff --git a/data/50unattended-upgrades.Ubuntu b/data/50unattended-upgrades.Ubuntu
index 49c4daf..b3b4910 100644
--- a/data/50unattended-upgrades.Ubuntu
+++ b/data/50unattended-upgrades.Ubuntu
@@ -68,8 +68,9 @@ Unattended-Upgrade::DevRelease "auto";
 
 // Send email to this address for problems or packages upgrades
 // If empty or unset then no email is sent, make sure that you
-// have a working mail setup on your system. A package that provides
-// 'mailx' must be installed. E.g. "user@example.com"
+// have a working mail setup on your system. A package providing
+// /usr/bin/mail or /usr/sbin/sendmail must be installed.
+// E.g. "user@example.com"
 //Unattended-Upgrade::Mail "";
 
 // Set this value to one of:
diff --git a/unattended-upgrade b/unattended-upgrade
index 583b297..24a9fcf 100755
--- a/unattended-upgrade
+++ b/unattended-upgrade
@@ -1676,7 +1676,8 @@ def send_summary_mail(pkgs,                 # type: List[str]
     if not os.path.exists(MAIL_BINARY) and not os.path.exists(SENDMAIL_BINARY):
         logging.error(_("No /usr/bin/mail or /usr/sbin/sendmail, "
                         "can not send mail. "
-                        "You probably want to install the mailx package."))
+                        "Install and configure a package providing "
+                        "/usr/bin/mail or /usr/sbin/sendmail."))
         return
 
     # The admin may well wish to get a mail report regardless of what was done.
@@ -1763,7 +1764,7 @@ def send_summary_mail(pkgs,                 # type: List[str]
     else:
         raise AssertionError(
             "This should never be reached as we previously validated that we "
-            "either have sendmail or mailx. Maybe they've been removed in "
+            "either have sendmail or mail. Maybe they've been removed in "
             "this right moment?")
     logging.debug("mail returned: %s", ret)
